conflict: none — did not build, stage, or assemble
choice_reason: A keeps the breaking-change note pinned visible under any search and says so on the page, while B's search filters the breaking note out of view on a non-matching query (reproduced live: with 'zzz-no-match-zzz' typed, B's #breaking section is hidden) — a direct risk to the release engineer's job. A's no-results state names the term, explains the pinned breaking note, and offers a clear-search recovery; B's is a bare generic line. A's packet evidence demonstrates every required state; B's interaction/state captures are unstyled and fail to show the copy confirmation or the no-results state, so B's behaviors could only be confirmed by reproducing them from source.
suspected_unblinding: A's sanitized app.js contains methodology-flavored comments and markup ('Objection First framing', 'S1 secondary action', 'A11Y-08', data-el="E0".."E9") that read like a named design-rules system, which could make the treated build guessable to a reviewer familiar with the method. No builder or team identity was inferable.

findings.label: B
findings.description: In-page search filters the breaking-change note out of view, so a non-matching query hides the one note that can stop a release.
findings.evidence: Reproduced live from B/source served locally: after typing 'zzz-no-match-zzz' into #note-search, #breaking is hidden (breaking_visible_during_no_match=false); B/source/app.js applies the filter to all [data-note] sections including the breaking one.

findings.label: B
findings.description: The packet's interaction and state evidence is defective: all four capture screenshots render unstyled (default browser fonts, raw buttons), state-01 shows no visible copy confirmation, and state-02 shows every entry still visible despite the no-match query typed in the search box, so neither required state is actually demonstrated by the packet.
findings.evidence: B/evidence/state-01-copy-confirmation.png, B/evidence/state-02-search-no-results.png, B/evidence/interaction-01-jump-to-breaking-changes.png, B/evidence/interaction-03-navigate-to-configuration-reference.png; behaviors confirmed only by my own local reproduction from B/source.

findings.label: B
findings.description: No skip link, and search filtering changes are not announced to assistive technology — there is no live-region status for result counts or the no-results message.
findings.evidence: B/source/index.html (only aria-live element is #copy-confirm; #no-results has no role/aria-live); reproduced first Tab stop is the jump button, not a skip link.

findings.label: B
findings.description: The clipboard fallback path reports 'Copied!' without verifying that document.execCommand('copy') succeeded, so the confirmation can be false in restricted environments.
findings.evidence: B/source/app.js lines 37-53 (catch block runs execCommand, then unconditionally sets 'Copied!').
